title: Anime Expo 2026 World Championship
location: Los Angeles Convention Center, CA, USA
description: Anime Expo brings fans together for cosplay, guest panels, screenings, and time to meet other people who love the same shows. There is usually a lot to see, so it helps to plan your day ahead.

title: Jump Festa 2026 Winter Summit
location: Makuhari Messe, Chiba, Tokyo, Japan
description: Jump Festa is Shueisha's annual celebration of manga and anime. Fans come for stage events, creator news, announcements, and exclusive goods from their favorite series.

title: Demon Slayer Infinity Castle Gala Watch Party
location: Shibuya TOHO Cinemas, Tokyo, Japan
description: Fans gathered for a late-night screening of the Infinity Castle story, with orchestral music adding to the atmosphere. It was a chance to watch a major Demon Slayer moment together.

title: Summer Game Fest 2026 Live Showcase
location: YouTube Theater, Inglewood, CA, USA
description: Summer Game Fest brings together new game announcements, trailers, and gameplay reveals. The live show gives fans a chance to react to the biggest news as it happens.

title: The Game Awards 2026 Spectacular
location: Peacock Theater, Los Angeles, CA, USA
description: The Game Awards looks back at the year's releases, celebrates standout games, and shares new trailers. The show also includes live performances and the annual Game of the Year award.

title: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree Speedrun Invitational
location: Messe Köln, Cologne, Germany
description: Skilled Soulsborne players raced through the Shadow of the Erdtree content, with a special focus on finishing without taking a hit. It was a chance to see how much practice and route knowledge speedrunning takes.

title: San Diego Comic-Con Hall H Studio Blowout
location: San Diego Convention Center, CA, USA
description: Hall H is known for studio panels, cast appearances, trailers, and major entertainment announcements. The room fills quickly, and fans often line up well before the presentations begin.

title: Dune: Messiah IMAX 70mm Worldwide Premiere
location: BFI IMAX, Waterloo, London, UK
description: The premiere pairs an IMAX screening with a red carpet and a conversation with director Denis Villeneuve and members of the cast. The event focuses on the next chapter of the Dune films.

title: Marvel Multiverse All-Night Retrospective
location: El Capitan Theatre, Hollywood, CA, USA
description: Fans spent the night watching Marvel films, joining trivia rounds, and looking at prop displays. Costumes were welcome, so the theater felt like a small convention as much as a movie marathon.

title: Stranger Things Final Season Global Fan Experience
location: Javits Center, New York City, NY, USA
description: This fan event recreates spots from Hawkins and the Upside Down, with an arcade, cast conversations, and previews tied to the final season of Stranger Things.

title: Arcane Season 2 Music & Art Gallery Gala
location: Grand Palais Éphémère, Paris, France
description: The exhibition brings together Arcane concept art, large-scale Hextech props, and music from the series performed live. It offers a closer look at how the show's world was designed.

title: House of the Dragon Season 2 Watch Party & Medieval Banquet
location: Edinburgh Castle Esplanade, Scotland, UK
description: Guests dressed in Westerosi-inspired outfits for a themed meal and an outdoor screening of the season premiere. The castle setting made it feel like a proper evening in the world of House of the Dragon.

title: KCON Worldwide Los Angeles 2026
location: Crypto.com Arena & LA Convention Center, CA, USA
description: KCON brings music, dance, food, and Korean pop culture together across several days. The Los Angeles event includes convention activities as well as performances from a range of artists.

title: BTS Full Reunion 2026 World Tour Kickoff
location: Seoul Olympic Stadium, Seoul, South Korea
description: The tour kickoff brings all seven BTS members back on stage for a stadium show in Seoul. Fans can expect group performances alongside songs from across the band's catalogue.

title: NewJeans Tokyo Dome Bunnies Camp
location: Tokyo Dome, Tokyo, Japan
description: NewJeans met fans at Tokyo Dome for two nights of live music, including acoustic arrangements and throwback covers. The event gave Bunnies a chance to hear familiar songs in a different way.

title: New York Comic Con 2026 Artist Alley Expo
location: Jacob K. Javits Center, New York, NY, USA
description: Artist Alley gives visitors a chance to meet comic artists and writers, browse original work, and get books signed. Many creators also offer sketches, prints, and special covers.

title: Free Comic Book Day 2026 Festivities
location: Local Comic Shops Worldwide & Midtown Comics NYC
description: Comic shops take part by offering selected free issues and hosting signings or other local events. It is an easy way for new readers to try a series and for regulars to find something unexpected.

title: DC Fandome Virtual Multi-verse Experience
location: Burbank Warner Bros. Studios / Online Global Broadcast
description: The online event shared updates about DC projects, including the Chapter 1: Gods and Monsters slate. Viewers could watch trailers and announcements from home.

title: Comic Market 106 (Comiket) Summer 2026
location: Tokyo Big Sight, Ariake, Koto-ku, Tokyo, Japan
description: Comiket is a huge gathering for self-published comics, fan works, and independent creators. Visitors browse artist booths, meet makers, and pick up books that can be hard to find elsewhere.

title: Angoulême International Comics & Manga Festival 2027
location: Angoulême, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France
description: The festival celebrates comics and graphic storytelling with exhibitions, talks, signings, and workshops. Its program brings together creators and readers from France and beyond.

title: Berserk Legacy Art Exhibition by Kentaro Miura
location: Sunshine City Exhibition Hall, Ikebukuro, Tokyo, Japan
description: The exhibition looks back at Kentaro Miura's work through original pages, artwork, and displays inspired by Berserk. It gives fans a chance to appreciate the care behind the series' striking imagery.
